chart.zoomHint: Hold Ctrl and scroll to zoom
chart.zoomHintMac: Hold Cmd and scroll to zoom
chart.resizeHandle: Drag to change the chart height
chart.keyboardHint: Arrow keys move between units, Enter opens the unit, Escape closes it.

request.title: Request a change to this unit
request.hint: Describe the change and the reason. Every Super Admin is notified and tracks the request under Settings, Organisation.
request.whatPlaceholder: For example: rename the unit, add a section, move it under another sector
request.sent: Your request has reached the Super Admin
request.failed: The request could not be sent

organisationTab.editorHint: Drag a unit onto another to move it with everything beneath it. Use the plus to add a child at any level, click a name to rename it in both languages, and open the menu for everything else. Every save takes a snapshot.
organisationTab.superAdminOnly: Only a Super Admin may change the structure.
organisationTab.movePreview: Preview: {unit} moves under {target}. Drop to confirm.
organisationTab.confirmMoveHint: Everything beneath the unit moves with it. The change can be undone.

impact.loading: Counting what is beneath the unit
impact.nothing: Nothing is beneath this unit and nothing points at it.
impact.policies: {count, plural, one {# policy or procedure} other {# policies and procedures}}
impact.ownedItems: {count, plural, one {# owned strategy item} other {# owned strategy items}}
impact.openHandovers: {count, plural, one {# open handover} other {# open handovers}}
impact.hrRisks: {count, plural, one {# HR risk} other {# HR risks}}
impact.other: {count, plural, one {# other link} other {# other links}}

organisationTab.riskHint: Everything listed below is reassigned to the unit you choose before the change is made. Nothing is left without a unit, and the change can be undone.
organisationTab.reassignRequired: Choose the unit that takes over before continuing.
organisationTab.undoFailed: The change could not be undone
organisationTab.sortHint: Lower numbers come first among siblings.
organisationTab.levelsHint: The level names appear on the chart's rail and on every unit. Drag to reorder from the top down. A level can only be removed when no unit uses it.
organisationTab.levelInUse: {count, plural, one {# unit uses this level} other {# units use this level}}
organisationTab.snapshotsHint: A snapshot of the whole structure is taken on every save. Restoring one replaces the structure with what the snapshot holds. The present structure is saved first, and any unit the snapshot does not know is kept as inactive so nothing is lost.
organisationTab.snapshotRestoreHint: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} in the snapshot. The present structure is saved first, so this can be undone.
organisationTab.snapshotRestored: Structure restored: {restored} updated, {inserted} added, {deactivated} kept inactive
organisationTab.csvHint: Columns: code, parent_code, level, name_en, name_ar, head_name, head_title. Existing codes are updated, new codes are added, nothing is removed. Preview first; the import runs only when every row is valid.
organisationTab.csvApply: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
organisationTab.csvNoRows: No rows were found in the file.
organisationTab.csvErrors: {count, plural, one {# row has an error} other {# rows have errors}}. Fix them before importing.

csvErrorCodes.duplicate_code: The code appears twice in the file
csvErrorCodes.parent_is_self: A unit cannot be its own parent
csvErrorCodes.unknown_parent: The parent code exists neither in the file nor in the structure
csvErrorCodes.would_create_a_cycle: This parent would create a loop

organisationTab.requestsHint: Unit heads ask for changes here. Mark a request as applied once you have made the change, or decline it. The requester is notified either way.

errors.reassign_inside_subtree: Choose a unit outside the one being removed.
errors.reassign_required: Choose the unit that takes over first.
errors.unknown_parent: That parent unit does not exist.
